next.reason: 1985: format 2 is used for random access mode, or for dynamic access mode when records are retrieved randomly. 2023 §2023:14.9.30.4 GR19: without an explicit or implied NEXT or PREVIOUS 'the read is a random read and the rules for format 2 apply'; §2023:14.9.30.3 SR6 bars NEXT, PREVIOUS and AT END in random mode; §2023:14.9.30.3 SR9 implies NEXT in dynamic mode only when ADVANCING, AT END or NOT AT END is written, so other dynamic-mode READs stay random. The same READs are random under both editions.
